name: phone-a-friend
description: Get second opinions, repository reviews, structured Q&A and multi-backend team feedback in local Claude Code. Relay to separately configured Antigravity, Codex, Gemini, Claude, OpenCode, pi or Ollama backends. Full operation requires Node.js 22.13+, the phone-a-friend CLI on PATH, and backend accounts or model servers. Installation does not install or authenticate them. Requests reach the selected provider; PaF keeps local history by default.
